question: Among female patients with proteinuria above normal levels, find those whose total cholesterol decreased by more than 10% from November to December of any year. Return their ID, age, and the percentage decrease.

prediction.sql: SELECT P."XCL_058" AS ID, L."XCL_016" AS Age, ((nov."XCL_026" - dec."XCL_026") * 100.0) / nov."XCL_026" AS PercentageDecrease FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS nov ON P."XCL_058" = nov."XCL_014" INNER JOIN Laboratory AS dec ON P."XCL_058" = dec."XCL_014" INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014" WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F' AND NOT nov."XCL_026" IS NULL AND NOT dec."XCL_026" IS NULL AND nov."XCL_026" > 0 AND nov."XCL_026" > dec."XCL_026" AND ((nov."XCL_026" - dec."XCL_026") * 100.0) / nov."XCL_026" > 10 AND STRFTIME('%m', nov."XCL_015") = '11' AND STRFTIME('%m', dec."XCL_015") = '12' AND STRFTIME('%Y', nov."XCL_015") = STRFTIME('%Y', dec."XCL_015") AND P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT L2."XCL_014" FROM Laboratory AS L2 WHERE NOT L2."XCL_045" IS NULL AND NOT L2."XCL_045" IN ('-', '0', '<0.002'))

measures.eligibility_application: nov and dec are specific lab records for November and December of the same year
measures.multiplicity_argument: The November and December joins are constrained by month and year, so each qualifying pair is a distinct observation; the age join may add multiplicity but is not an aggregate denominator.

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    L."XCL_016" AS Age,
    ((nov."XCL_026" - dec."XCL_026") * 100.0) / nov."XCL_026" AS PercentageDecrease
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS nov
    ON P."XCL_058" = nov."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS dec
    ON P."XCL_058" = dec."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE
    P."XCL_059" = 'F'
    AND nov."XCL_026" IS NOT NULL
    AND dec."XCL_026" IS NOT NULL
    AND nov."XCL_026" > 0
    AND nov."XCL_026" > dec."XCL_026"
    AND ((nov."XCL_026" - dec."XCL_026") * 100.0) / nov."XCL_026" > 10
    AND STRFTIME('%m', nov."XCL_015") = '11'
    AND STRFTIME('%m', dec."XCL_015") = '12'
    AND STRFTIME('%Y', nov."XCL_015") = STRFTIME('%Y', dec."XCL_015")
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS L2
        WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
          AND L2."XCL_045" IS NOT NULL
          AND L2."XCL_045" NOT IN ('-', '0', '<0.002')
    )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS Age,
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_015" LIKE '%-11-%' THEN L."XCL_019" ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_015" LIKE '%-12-%' THEN L."XCL_019" ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0)
    / SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_015" LIKE '%-11-%' THEN L."XCL_019" ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageDecrease
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND L."XCL_021" > 5.5
GROUP BY P."XCL_058"
HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_015" LIKE '%-11-%' THEN L."XCL_019" ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_015" LIKE '%-12-%' THEN L."XCL_019" ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_015" LIKE '%-11-%' THEN L."XCL_019" ELSE 0 END) > 10
